text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:
- Norway beat Hungary 3-0 in a World Cup soccer European group three qualifier with Kjetil Rekdal scoring a rare hat trick within eight minutes.

- Economics Professor Preben Munthe says that the bank crisis in 1990 was created by government regulations on losses in the financial sector. As a result of the crisis, shareholders in major banks lost their shares when the banks were taken over by the state.

- Environment Minister Torbjoern Berntsen says he may ask parliament for the right to temporarily ban the establishing of shopping centres. Berntsen says shopping centres cause extra car traffic in cities.
- Invested capital from abroad increased by 9.4 billions to 124.5 billion crowns in 1995 although Norway is not a member of the European Union. About 90 percent of the growth came from EU members.
- Saga Petroleum ASA will increase investments considerably and is looking at the British sector for growth.
